targets.query: SELECT mean("device") FROM "default"."scaleio.device.latency.read" WHERE ("cluster"::tag =~ /^$cluster$/ AND "protection_domain_name"::tag =~ /^$domain$/ AND "storage_node_name"::tag =~ /^$storage_node$/ AND "device_name"::tag =~ /^$device$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "device_name", "device_path" fill(null)

panels.title: Average Read IO Size per Disk

targets.query: SELECT mean("device") FROM "default"."scaleio.device.iosize.write" WHERE ("cluster" =~ /^$cluster$/ AND "protection_domain_name" =~ /^$domain$/ AND "storage_node"::tag =~ /^$storage_node$/ AND "device_name" =~ /^$device$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "device_name", "device_path" fill(null)

panels.title: Average Write IO Size per Disk

list.name: device
